dataSource: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (no API key); NSE public F&O underlying list with public GitHub snapshot fallback
marketDataNote: Free, no-key source configuration. Yahoo Finance may be delayed, incomplete or rate-limited; stale candles are flagged, not treated as live quotes. Verify quotes and order levels before trading.

paperTradeTracker.methodology: Underlying stock price only; BUY bullish breakout / SELL bearish breakdown; stop 0.50%, Target 1 1.00% (1:2), Target 2 1.50% (1:3). Paper entries allowed 09:15–10:59 IST; remaining open trades close at the latest completed candle at or before 11:00 IST. If one candle touches stop and target, stop-loss is recorded first. No option premium, brokerage or slippage simulated.

scanSummary.universeSource: existing symbol universe + current F&O underlyings
scanSummary.powerScoreMeaning: Relative ranking score out of 100; not a probability or guaranteed prediction.
